text:
Nina Alvarez: quick postmortem note from the dedicated canary: streaming loader stalled on a gzipped safetensors file and blocked the hotstart.
Tomás Rivera: saw that, stack traces show decoder waiting for header frames that never came.
Jia Liu: root cause seems to be inconsistent proxy path returning `content-length: 0` for range probe, making loader think it can stream.
Nina Alvarez: proposal: a compact "format-detect" probe header returned by HEAD requests: `x-rw-format-detect: sf|sf+gz|tar|bin`. small enum.
Tomás Rivera: agree. add local loader cache (TTL 30s) to avoid extra HEADs during concurrent hotstarts.
Jia Liu: fallback order: 1) HEAD probe, 2) small-range GET (first 512B), 3) index-first load. Prefer index-first on unknown.
Nina Alvarez: telemetry: add probe_source=head|range|none and decision=index|stream. also add metric for probe latency.
infra-bot: created ISSUE-ML-1299: "format-detect HEAD header + loader fallback cache" assigned to Nina, Tomás, Jia. ETA: 2 sprints.
Tomás Rivera: test plan: unit header parsing, integration with gzipped safetensors, and chaos test where proxy lies about length.
Jia Liu: will draft the loader change PR and include the header enum and cache sketch.
Nina Alvarez: great, let's canary on 1% Dedicated, monitor OOMs and hotstart latency. :thumbsup:
